disabled_reason: Requires Copernicus ADS credentials (cdsapi config, e.g. ~/.cdsapirc, pointing at the ADS endpoint, not CDS).
unverified: No real fetch was run (credentials required and not checked); time, lead time and the full 72-variable request are untested against the ADS API.
notes: No model in the repo reads CAMS_FX (only tests, docs listing, CHANGELOG); variables = full CAMSGlobalLexicon.VOCAB (earth2studio/lexicon/cams.py): 22 single-level + 50 pressure-level.
